name: Bad Homburg vor der Höhe (Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of blue, white and blue, charged below the centre with the city arms of Bad Homburg vor der Höhe (a white chevron on blue under a crown).
history: The city colours are blue and white; the city bears two banner flags, with and without the arms, which were granted in 1903.

features.role: Bad Homburg arms — white chevron on blue with crown
